name: Pollo AI
desc: One interface over many image and video generation models.
desc_zh: 把多个图像与视频生成模型收进同一个界面。
solves: Lets you try several generation models side by side instead of committing to one vendor's look.
solves_zh: 可以横向试多种生成模型，不必锁定某一家画风。
best_for: Reaching for it when no single model reliably gives you the style you need.
best_for_zh: 单一模型总给不出你要的风格时。
notes: 外部发现渠道补录：AIwith.me tool directory recommendations for AI image and video generators。来源：https://pollo.ai
